name: Nominate
rule: Create a brief only for an active workflow, repeated question or useful entity; retain an explicit reason. Do not summarize every message into every entity.
fields: Entity ID, business/matter scope, audience class, intended use, source references and creation reason.
test: An unrelated new supplier message does not rewrite every outlet brief.

name: Compile
rule: Synthesize across eligible episodes. Label accepted fact, tentative interpretation, scoped preference, approved procedure and narrative separately. Critical quantities/statuses come from the shared version-bound result.
fields: Brief ID/version, claim or section dependencies, source spans/timestamps, record revisions, model/extractor version, coverage and unresolved questions.
test: Two repeated summaries of one complaint still represent one underlying observation.

name: Invalidate
rule: A matching correction, backfill, processed attachment, extractor/policy change or grant change marks affected claims for revalidation. Use reverse dependencies plus scoped selectors for absence claims. A source timestamp alone is insufficient.
fields: Changed dependency, invalidation reason, affected claims/views, queued refresh and historical version.
test: A late credit note invalidates the matching no-credit conclusion; unrelated supplier briefs remain valid.

name: Refresh
rule: Revalidate operationally critical values before reliance. Batch or lazily refresh descriptive synthesis with explicit freshness. Under budget pressure, retain originals and show pending coverage; never silently present old synthesis as current.
fields: Last successful refresh, evaluated source/processing revisions, refresh mode, pending/failed status, budget and retry state.
test: Correction arrives during refresh: version check prevents publishing a superseded brief as current.

name: Use & inspect
rule: Retrieve only currently allowed content. Use fresh records for current quantities, dates and state; briefs explain history and select further evidence. Show what the assistant knows, why, uncertainty and what changed. A user can flag irrelevant context without deleting evidence.
fields: Requester, purpose, destination audience, policy revision, selected brief/record versions and source citations.
test: Revoke an accountant source: its content cannot leak through the cached supplier brief or its title.

name: Retire & evaluate
rule: Supersede historical briefs, apply retention/deletion to derivatives and indexes, and promote useful knowledge/procedures only at the appropriate scope. Preserve correction history under policy; generated answers never become fresh independent evidence.
fields: Supersession, retention policy, approved scope/owner, evaluation version and rollback reference.
test: New related question improves with corrected history; one-off exception does not become a standing rule.
